commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Edward Kenway ({2}{U}{B}{R} 5/5 legendary Human Assassin Pirate; Assassin's Creed acr, released 2024-07-05; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). At our end step he makes a Treasure for each tapped Assassin, Pirate and/or Vehicle we control (each permanent counted once). Whenever a Vehicle we control deals combat damage to a player, he exiles that player's top card face down and we may play it for as long as it stays exiled. Plan: attack with evasive Pirates and Vehicles (crewing taps more bodies, over-crew is legal), collect Treasures each end step, keep the stolen cards, and convert artifacts into cards (Fateful Discovery, Academy Manufactor), extra turns (Time Sieve) or drain (Mirkwood Bats).
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized). Game Changers: 10 in baseline and candidate (Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Cyclonic Rift, Fierce Guardianship, Force of Will, Imperial Seal, Jeska's Will, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Vampiric Tutor). Commander Spellbook find-my-combos: 5 complete combos in both lists (Malcolm, Keen-Eyed Navigator + Glint-Horn Buccaneer, and Time Sieve lines), almost-included 43 -> 45. No new combo and no unconditional infinite is claimed: Malcolm + Glint-Horn is a near-infinite that needs at least two opponents; the Sieve lines need five artifacts every turn.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Edward's Oracle: Mu Yanling and Brotherhood Vertibird make Vehicles connect for his theft; Spectral Sailor and Malcolm, the Eyes are evasive Pirates that are tapped at end step; Mirkwood Bats turns his Treasures into a drain. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis pirate decks, baseline -> candidate): Admiral Beckett Brass 50 -> 49; Admiral Brass, Unsinkable 48 -> 46 (logical representative: canonical Archidekt export 03_Admiral_Brass_Unsinkable.txt, because no file matched its approved hash e66e3a59); Don Andres, the Renegade 49 -> 47; Nathan Drake, Treasure Hunter 47 -> 45. Of the five adds only Spectral Sailor appears in another pirate deck (Beckett Brass). The shared core is the mana base, fast mana, free interaction and the strongest Pirates; separation is commander-first: every add serves Edward's tapped count or his Vehicle combat-damage theft. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Sulfur Falls, Revel in Riches, Setzer, Mechanized Production; Magmatic Galleon, Admiral Beckett Brass, Fell Flagship, Corsair Captain, Lifecraft Engine, Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel, Blood Money, Back in Town, Pitiless Plunderer, Storm the Vault, Xorn, Rain of Riches, Treasure Map, Mech Hangar and tribal taplands, Mobilizer Mech, Reckoner Bankbuster, Cargo Ship, Careening Mine Cart, The Thanos-Copter, Overpowering Attack, Unstoppable Plan, Shao Jun, Coercive Recruiter, Forerunner of the Coalition, Great Gilded Boat, Unwinding Clock, Weatherlight) are not re-added. No explicit owner keep is cut: all five cuts were plain RETAIN lines in the owner's 2026-10-14 ledger; Fateful Discovery (explicit keep) stays, and the Pass C swap that would cut it is staged.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (97 library rows; Island and Swamp 2x each, everything else 1x).
Roles:
- 35 lands, including Ancient Tomb, Cavern of Souls, Urza's Saga, Otawara, Training Center, Exotic Orchard and nine fetchlands.
- Rocks and fast mana: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Mana Vault, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, three Talismans; Fellwar Stone and Lotus Petal are cut.
- Vehicles (13 -> 13): Smuggler's Copter, Jackdaw, Adrestia, Deluxe Dragster, Skysovereign, The Indomitable, The Belligerent, Subterranean Schooner, Nautiloid Ship, Luxurious Locomotive, Hoard Hauler, RMS Titanic; Imposter Mech is cut; Brotherhood Vertibird and Mu Yanling's token are new.
- Pirates and Assassins (21 -> 21 including Edward): Breeches, Brazen Plunderer and Captain Lannery Storm are cut; Spectral Sailor and Malcolm, the Eyes are new.
- Treasure and card engines: Academy Manufactor, Fateful Discovery, Coastal Piracy, Black Market Connections, Ramirez, Vaan, Don Andres, Malcolm, Keen-Eyed Navigator; Mirkwood Bats is new.
- Finishers: Time Sieve, Port Razer, Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Roaming Throne.
- Interaction: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Swan Song, Deflecting Swat, Captain Storm, Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Toxic Deluge, Hostage Taker, Kitesail Larcenist, Siren Stormtamer.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline and candidate: 35 lands (5 basics: 2 Island, 2 Swamp, 1 Mountain), coloured sources unchanged. Durable rocks 7 -> 6 (Fellwar cut) and Lotus Petal cut. Exact multivariate-hypergeometric test (strict: lands plus durable rocks, U, B and R, at least five sources by turn 5): with Petal counted 0.5538/0.6544 -> 0.5025/0.6038 (play/draw); with Petal excluded 0.5283/0.6295 -> 0.5025/0.6038. Moxen, Ancient Tomb's extra mana and Treasure makers are excluded, so these are floors. Average nonland MV 2.797 -> 2.844; creatures 24 -> 26 (including Edward).
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Swan Song, Deflecting Swat. Removal: Cyclonic Rift, Deadly Rollick, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Hostage Taker, Kitesail Larcenist, Skysovereign. Wipe: Toxic Deluge (Vehicles that are not crewed survive it). Protection: Siren Stormtamer, Otawara, Cavern of Souls. Weak points: a five-mana commander; artifact wipes hit Vehicles, Treasures and Vertibird; Mu's flying grant ends if she dies; Bats is a removable 2/3.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: An approved Bracket 4 Edward list (2026-10-14) built on Pirate and Vehicle attacks, Treasure, theft and Time Sieve. M6 Pass C (#17) is NEEDS TESTING (owner-equivalent substitute, NOT independent; 0 measured playtests). Its first-priority hypothesis was +Mirkwood Bats / -Fateful Discovery, with +Bats / -Adrestia as a secondary stress test. Weakest five plain-retained slots: Breeches, Brazen Plunderer (temporary theft), Imposter Mech (board-dependent), Fellwar Stone (opponent-dependent rock), Lotus Petal (one-shot) and Captain Lannery Storm (ground 2/2).

material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Breeches, Brazen Plunderer, a 4-MV menace Pirate whose damage trigger exiles each damaged opponent's top card, playable THIS TURN only. It is plainly retained in the owner's 2026-10-14 ledger (no stated reason), not an explicit keep. Notable: 50% of EDHREC Edward decks.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: Edward's second ability needs a Vehicle to deal combat damage to a player. Mu gives all 13 Vehicles flying (702.9b); only 5 in the candidate fly on their own (4 in the baseline). So each Vehicle attack is far more likely to connect and steal a card for as long as it stays exiled. The token is a Vehicle (counts tapped at end step) and crew 1 can be paid by Mu herself. Card draw on the same connection.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: A 4-MV creature that dies to everything; the flying grant disappears with her. Losing Breeches removes a Pirate body (Pirate count 21 is kept by Spectral Sailor and Malcolm).
material_candidates.reason: Turns Edward's own combat-damage text from 'if unblocked' into 'usually'; Breeches' theft is temporary and duplicates Edward, Ramirez and Vaan.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Staged Pass C exact swap (Bats over Fateful Discovery) inside a complete five-swap, keeping Fellwar Stone; overrides the explicit owner keep of Fateful Discovery, so not the primary.
Staged Pass C secondary swap (Bats over Adrestia), keeping Fellwar; weaker on identity because it loses a Vehicle.
Staged four-swap without Bats, keeping Fellwar Stone; below the five-swap floor.
Staged five-swap with Chandra, Spark Hunter instead of Mu Yanling.
Staged six-swap with Eagle Vision over Imperial Seal.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C's exact hypothesis (+Mirkwood Bats / -Fateful Discovery) was run as a bounded finite test. Bats is castable more often (0.836 vs 0.631 with 12 cards seen) and drains 6 per opponent where Fateful draws 6 in the Manufactor/2-qualifier state. But Fateful is an explicit owner keep and its explosive mode is real, so the primary places Bats over Fellwar Stone instead. The exact Pass C swap and the Adrestia variant are staged as complete 100s.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Edward's theft text only fires when a Vehicle deals combat damage to a player, yet 9 of the baseline's 13 Vehicles had no evasion and nothing granted it. Four slots were also spent on temporary or board-dependent effects (Breeches' this-turn theft, Imposter Mech) and one-shot or opponent-dependent mana (Petal, Fellwar).
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Five swaps: Mu Yanling gives every Vehicle flying (and a crew-1 Vehicle token), Brotherhood Vertibird is a flying Vehicle that scales with Treasure, Spectral Sailor and Malcolm, the Eyes are evasive Pirates tapped for Edward each end step, and Mirkwood Bats turns tokens into a drain. Measured cost disclosed: turn-5 strict castability 0.5283 -> 0.5025 on the play (Petal excluded). Spellbook combos unchanged (5 -> 5).

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: The five-swap floor was reached with five swaps that each stand on their own; the floor was not a target and no sixth swap cleared the bar. Every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool: eight post-floor challenges were recorded on Edward-specific grounds, and a six-swap package (Eagle Vision over Imperial Seal) is staged as a complete 100.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Eagle Vision draws three for two mana after Edward connects, but Seal finds the specific engine piece (Time Sieve, Locomotive, Manufactor) at one mana; the owner retained it among the tutors.
Freebooter is an evasive Pirate, but its card is only taken temporarily; Vaan turns stolen cards into more value and is in the owner's theft group.
Kindred Discovery costs five and ignores Vehicles; Coastal Piracy draws on every connecting creature, crewed Vehicles included.
With Mu Yanling every Vehicle flies, so Schooner's ground weakness is reduced; Sloop is a sidegrade at the same cost.
Mutavault is a tapped qualifier for one Treasure but is colourless; the deck needs U, B and R for a five-mana commander.
Possession Engine is a Vehicle but costs five and is slow; Hostage Taker steals at once and is a Pirate.
Airship copies itself after Treasure sacrifices, but costs four with BB; Copter flies and loots at two.
Navigator's extra turn needs ten permanents and is one-shot; Port Razer's extra combats repeat on a Pirate body.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Edward is an Assassin and our commander, so Eagle Vision's freerunning makes it a 2-mana draw three after he connects.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Imperial Seal tutors the deck's key engine (Time Sieve, Locomotive, Manufactor) for one mana; Eagle Vision needs Edward himself to connect and costs five otherwise. The owner retained Seal among the tutors.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on Edward-specific grounds: Imperial Seal finds the engine for one mana (Eagle Vision staged); Fateful Discovery is an explicit owner keep (the Pass C swap is staged); Vaan, Coastal Piracy, Schooner, Xander's Lounge, Hostage Taker, Copter and Port Razer beat their challengers. Cutting more mana would push turn-5 castability further below 0.50.
